description: Get the assignments aligned to outcomes in a course, optionally filtered to one student_id or assignment_id. Returns each alignment's assignment_id and title, but not the outcome_id it maps to. get_outcome_results nests the same alignment objects under linked.alignments, but ties an alignment to an outcome via each outcome_results[] entry's links.alignment and links.learning_outcome, not from linked.alignments alone. Use get_outcome_contributing_scores to see the assignment scores that produced an outcome's results instead of just the links.

assignment_id.description: Optional Canvas assignment ID to filter alignments by.

student_id.description: Optional Canvas user ID of the student to filter alignments by.

name: get_outcome_alignments
title: Get Outcome Alignments
